findings.evidence: `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean:391` has `@[expose, simps n center dom] def ofBaseSet` for any `E`, and `exists_closure_dom_subset` (line 136) already uses `ChartedSpace.locallyCompactSpace E M`. In this PR, `ClosedUpperHalfPlane` matters only for the `LocallyCompactSpace` instance inside `exists_enlarge`.
findings.fix: State them for any model `E` and move them to `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean`. `exists_enlarge` would take `[LocallyCompactSpace E] [T2Space M]`, like `exists_closure_dom_subset`. Keep only `halfCoord_enlarge` in the bordered files.
findings.issue: `enlarge`, `chart_enlarge`, `triv_enlarge`, `coord_enlarge` and `exists_enlarge` only accept the model `ClosedUpperHalfPlane`, yet nothing in them depends on it. Their natural home is `FiniteBundleAtlas/Basic.lean`, next to `ofBaseSet`, which uses the same pattern for any model `E`.

findings.evidence: Main proof: `hA := fun z hz ↦ by obtain ⟨hz, hz0⟩ := A.mem_halfImage.1 hz; obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := A.mem_image.1 hz; exact B.mem_halfImage.2 ⟨B.mem_image.2 ⟨x, subset_closure.trans (hAU j) hx, hxz⟩, hz0⟩`. By comparison, `ofBaseSet` comes with `image_ofBaseSet`, `overlap_ofBaseSet` and `transition_ofBaseSet` (Basic.lean:412–422).
findings.fix: Add `image_le_image_enlarge : A.image j ≤ (A.enlarge U hU hAU hUc hUs).image j` and `halfImage_le_halfImage_enlarge` (derived from `hAU`), and use them for `hA`/`hle'`.
findings.issue: `enlarge` has no lemma relating its chart images to those of `A`. As a result `isCompactOperator_lowerOrderL` proves `A.halfImage j ⊆ B.halfImage j` (`hA`) and the closure inclusion (`hVW`) by hand, unpacking `mem_image`/`mem_halfImage`.

summary: `FiniteBundleAtlas.enlarge` and `exists_enlarge` are general atlas tools but are tied to `ClosedUpperHalfPlane` and placed in the bordered Rellich file, and `enlarge` has no lemma saying its chart images contain those of `A`. Without that lemma the main proof works out the inclusion by hand twice.
